Create a new LOGOS project in a new directory.

Scaffolds a complete project structure including: - `Largo.toml` manifest file - `src/main.lg` entry point with a "Hello, world!" example - `.gitignore` configured for LOGOS projects

# Example

```bash largo new my_project cd my_project largo run ```

Usage: largo new [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          The project name, used for the directory and package name

Options:
      --web
          Scaffold a full-stack website: a backend of `## Route`s ending in `Serve on port 8080.` (`src/main.lg`), pages compiled to WASM (`pages/`), and static assets (`static/`) — all served by one `largo serve`. Pure convention: no extra manifest keys

      --site
          Scaffold a site: pages compiled to WASM (`pages/`) and static assets (`static/`), and no backend and no entry program — a `## Page` mounts itself. `largo serve` shows it; `largo build` exports it to `dist/` for any static host

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo new hello
  cd hello
  largo run

  largo new mysite --site
  cd mysite
  largo serve

  largo new myapp --web
  cd myapp
  largo serve
